WHAT_IS_MEASURED_AND_WHAT_IS_NOT: Every field carries `basis`. MEASURED means derived from a committed close-out's systemd start/exit stamps and run record. PROJECTED means it has not been built yet. The ETH build cost is the only hole, and the night total inherits it.

eth_build_cost.why_no_number: No ETH stage has ever been built. Declining to convert the archive-volume ratio into a runtime is deliberate: the relationship between archive bytes and wall clock has not been measured.

the_only_evidence.what_it_does_NOT_establish: that runtime or peak RSS scale with archive bytes

eth_build_cost.how_to_close_it: one ETH day on 09-05 -- consumed, 288 windows, mask present, archives complete

de_valuation.how_measured: the heavy lock was held from 17:15:44Z to 18:33:44Z while be192tape0910 offered and was refused 77 times; the 78th attempt took it
de_valuation.OPEN_QUESTION_THAT_DECIDES_FEASIBILITY: whether a valuation needs BOTH coins. If it does, the night is build-then-value serial; if it does not, the critical path roughly halves. Asked of DE, unanswered.

scheduled_units.how_measured: Starting/Finished pairs in the user journal
scheduled_units.THE_SHAPE_THAT_MATTERS: The recurring scheduled load is SECONDS per hour. The long holds are CATCH-UP runs, which appear only when a day was missed -- `evaluation_pipeline --catch-up --since ... --max-days 1` held the lock 54:45 and counting at 01:21Z, against a median of 9.5s for the same unit idle. So the hazard is a backlog, not the clock.

NIGHT_BUDGET.basis: MEASURED where btc, PROJECTED where eth
NIGHT_BUDGET.fits: two coins (~60 measured btc + eth projected) plus ONE valuation (78 measured)
NIGHT_BUDGET.does_not_fit: two valuations plus a catch-up run
NIGHT_BUDGET.decided_by: whether the valuation needs both coins

RECOVERABILITY.why: no retention or prune policy exists over the raw archive (flow_intensity.py and be_gate1_fragment.py carry no RETENTION/retention_days/max_age; daily_pipeline.py's only unlinks are a temporary and a missing-marker). A delayed build reads identical bytes.
RECOVERABILITY.what_IS_unrecoverable: a day the collector never wrote properly -- 09-11's four hollow windows from the 18:49:08Z reboot are gone regardless of build timing. Contention delays; collection failure destroys.
